input_transform: Native uint8 raw rescaled to [-1,1]; local residual versus19x19 Gaussian sigma3, gain16, clipped[-1,1]; fixed, no dataset fitting
hard_negative: Training-only fixed SAM positive pixel centers with an entirely GT-empty native256 patch; rejection sampling then GT-empty breast fallback
augmentation: Independent horizontal and vertical reflections p=0.5 applied identically to image and target; no resizing
precision: BF16 convolution autocast; FP32 sigmoid, losses, overlap averaging, exported eligible-pixel probabilities; cuDNN deterministic with benchmark disabled
loss: Weighted BCE averaged across every patch pixel + soft Dice averaged across positive patches only; negative patches retain their full BCE contribution
selection: Largest mean across both fixed detector arms of positive-image macro Dice on complete internal-held images; then smaller mean negative FP pixels/image; then higher threshold; then predicted_boxes; then earlier epoch
refit: No refit. Lock the selected training-subset checkpoint and threshold/constraint; evaluate prior reserved once as additional CSAW diagnostic after adaptation.
inference_scope: Full native held image covered by image-only256 tiles at stride192 with overlap probability averaging; no GT-selected inference patches; afterwards apply fixed gate and detector-box/SAM constraints
reserved_usage: Original reserved images may be hashed for duplicate isolation; their masks and outcomes are not used for fitting, threshold, epoch, input transform, or combination selection
interpretation: Fully supervised CSAW development adaptation; previous reserved has already been evaluated, and is not an independent zero-shot external generalization test
